biggest_catch: Only available to existing Ameriprise Financial investment clients (and employees) - new customers without an Ameriprise investment relationship are not eligible. Offer window 07/01/2026-12/29/2026.
catches: Only available to existing Ameriprise Financial investment clients and employees of Ameriprise Financial, Inc. and its affiliates.
Open a new Ameriprise Bank Checking Account between July 1, 2026 and December 29, 2026.
Set up qualifying direct deposit(s) of at least $1,500 into the checking account within 90 calendar days of account opening.
Account must be open and in good standing when the bonus is credited.
Limit one checking bonus per the household/Group ID rules shown on the secure site (savings bonus is one per Group ID).
Clients who previously received an Ameriprise Bank checking bonus are not eligible.
Bonus credited within 14 business days after requirements are met; reported as interest on IRS Form 1099-INT.
Companion savings bonus tiers exist ($350/$650/$1,000 by deposit tier; taken as R0952). Combined headline: up to $1,400.
